content.title: Contractor Licenses
content.summary: In the City of Arvada, contractors must obtain a license to secure building or right-of-way permits, with specific licensing requirements based on the type of work performed. Homeowners working on their own residences are exempt from this requirement. Applications for licenses can be submitted online, and approval typically occurs within five business days, with various license types available depending on the scope of work, each requiring proof of qualifications and a signed affidavit of lawful presence.
content.body:
To obtain building permits or right-of-way permits in the City of Arvada, contractors must first obtain a license. ## Work that Requires a License # [Building Contractor](https://www.arvadaco.gov/265/Building-Contractor) The City of Arvada requires licensing for all contractors involved in the construction, alteration, remodeling, repairing, and equipping of buildings and structures. Homeowners doing work on their personal private residence in which they are the owner and occupy the structure are not considered contractors and are not required to obtain a contractor license. ## How to Apply All new applications and renewals of existing applications are completed online at the [Permit Portal]([NEW PORTAL URL]). Applications will be reviewed within 5 business days from submission. Once the application is approved, you will receive an email notification for payment. Payments can be completed online or checks are accepted via mail to 8101 Ralston Road, Arvada, CO 80002. Please make sure to include the AEC number of the name of the license on the check. ## What You Need to Apply 1. Proof of Qualifications (see the table below for license qualifications) 2. Signed Affidavit of lawful presence ## Qualifications for a Building Contractor License |License Type|Allowed Work|Requirements|License Fee| |---|---|---|---| |Builder's Unlimited
I-B|Construct, erect, add to, alter, demolish, or repair any building or structure. It is the responsibility of the licensee that all subcontractors in its employ are properly licensed.|Passing test from ICC F11 min or Licensed in a Colorado jurisdiction where you have tested.|$200| |Builder's Limited
II-B|Construct, erect, add to, alter, or repair any building or structure classified as less than a high rise, as defined by the International Building Code (IBC). The demolition of any building or structure classified as less than a high rise is permitted. The licensee may complete nonstructural interior finish or remodel of any type of building. The holder of a Class II-B license may perform any work authorized by a Class III-B and a Class IV-B license. It is the responsibility of the licensee that all subcontractors in its employ are properly licensed.|Passing test from ICC F12 min or Licensed in a Colorado jurisdiction where you have tested.|$150| |Builder's Miscellaneous
III-B|Construct, erect, alter or repair one- and two-family dwellings, U Occupancy buildings and attached single-unit dwellings (IRC townhouses). The demolition of any one- and two-dwelling building or U Occupancy building or structure is permitted. The holder of a Class III-B license may perform any work authorized by a Class IV-B license.|Passing test from ICC F13 min or Licensed in a Colorado jurisdiction where you have tested.|$75| |Builder's Sub Contractor
IV-B|This license shall be issued to those engaged in contracting for labor or for labor and material involving **only one trade**, such as masonry, framing, insulation, drywalling, glazing, concrete flat work, irrigation systems, siding, elevator contractors, solar panel installation, installation of radon mitigation system, fire detection systems, burglar alarms or building demolition, but shall not authorize any electrical, plumbing or mechanical work.|Passing test from ICC F12 min or 2 notarized letters.|$75| |Homeowner's "Limited"
V-B|This license shall be issued to an individual and is limited to the building of a single- family residence to be owned and occupied by the licensee. The licensee may perform all or part of the work personally or act as a general contractor; in either case, the licensee shall be fully responsible for the performance of all the work in accordance with the city's building codes and, further, shall pursue the completion of all work in an orderly and diligent manner. Documentation shall be submitted with the permit application to show that the individual owns the property to be built on and that if there is a construction loan; the loan is issued to the individual.||$50| |Plumbing
VI-P|This license shall entitle the holder to contract for and perform all work involving sanitary plumbing, potable water piping, the installation of plumbing appliances and apparatus and related plumbing work. To be qualified as a plumbing contractor, the person, firm, partnership, corporation, association or other organization must either be or employ full-time a **master** plumber licensed by the **State** according to C.R.S. § 12-155-101 et seq It shall be responsibility of the applicant to provide evidence of the state license to city.|State of Colorado Master Plumber State of Colorado Contractor License|$0| |Mechanical
VII-M|Erect, install or construct all mechanical systems, including hot water heating systems, air conditioning systems, refrigeration systems, or install boilers, evaporative coolers, and sheet metal work. This license shall entitle the holder to replace boilers, and evaporative coolers, and all connections thereto. Other connections to the potable water system must be performed by either a state-licensed master plumber in the employ of the licensed mechanical contractor or city-licensed plumbing contractor unless specifically exempted in the Colorado State Plumbing Code. Line voltage electrical work must be done by a city-registered electrical contractor.|Passing F29 test from ICC or License from Colorado jurisdiction where you have tested.|$75| |Moving
VII-D|Move any building or structure, subject to all applicable regulations of the city. Before a moving license is granted, the applicant shall file with the building official, a Certificate of Insurance in the same amounts and subject to the same requirements as for municipal contractors' licenses set forth in section 78-183.||$75| |Roofing
IX-R|This license shall entitle the holder to do roofing of any building or structure including nonstructural decking repair or replacement.|Passing test from ICC or License from Colorado jurisdiction where you have tested.|$75| |Electrical
IX-E|To be qualified for registration as an electrical contractor, an applicant must hold a valid electrical contractor's license issued by the state according to C.R.S. § 12-23-101 et seq.|State of Colorado Master Electrical State of Colorado Contractor License|$0| |Radio Amplification
RA|This registration shall entitle the holder to do installation of radio amplification system with buildings.|Certificate on in-building system training issued by nationally recognized organization, school or a certificate issued by a manufacture of the equipment being installed.|$0|Qualifications for a Building Contractor License ## Issued Licenses Once all requested paperwork and qualifications are submitted and the application is approved, the license will be emailed to you. # [Municipal General Contractor](https://www.arvadaco.gov/283/Municipal-General-Contractor) General public improvements, consisting of construction, reconstruction and remodeling of storm drains, irrigation ditches, fire lines, sewer and water lines, sewer and water mains, curb and gutters, sidewalks, streets, potholing, boring, traffic-control devices and similar improvements which are constructed on public rights of way, easements and other public property, and utility services on private property between the property line and the building require a licensed Municipal General Contractor to pull a permit, schedule an inspection and pass the required inspections. ## How to Apply - For a new license: visit the [Permit Portal]([NEW PORTAL URL]) and click on “Apply for Contractor License” under the contractor heading. Follow the instructions on the application and submit. All required documentation must be uploaded in order for the application to be reviewed.   - For a license renewal: visit the [Permit Portal]([NEW PORTAL URL]) and login in using your current AEC number. Follow the prompts to apply and submit. All required documentation must be uploaded in order for the application to be reviewed.  - See License Packets under Resources for instructions on how to apply and a list of required documents. - New license packet for contractors who have never had a license with the City of Arvada Engineering or your license  - Renewal license packet for contractors who have had a license with the City of Arvada Engineering but it is getting ready to expire or has just expired. - Review of applications may take up to 5 business days to complete   ## Required Documents 1. [Municipal Bond Form (PDF)](https://www.arvadaco.gov/DocumentCenter/View/298/Bond-Form-for-Municipal-Contractors-License-PDF) with power of attorney 2. Insurance and workman's compensation certificates with City of Arvada listed as additional insured. Examples of what is required are located under Resources on this page 3. [License fee](https://www.arvadaco.gov/DocumentCenter/View/294)
